bio: Although it has a new venue, this restaurant has retained its attractive friendly feel in a dining room that acts as a backdrop for substantial dishes that are full of flavour. The interesting classic menu is supplemented by a selection of daily specials, with meat, fish and vegetables (some grilled) prepared in front of guests seated at the counter. There are also traditional tables available and the lively atmosphere remains that of a friendly, welcoming bistro. Interesting wine list, including a selection of wines by the glass....
